test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Indian Railways has completed the world's highest railway-arch bridge over the ________ river in Jammu and Kashmir.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chenab. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Railway has completed the world's loftiest road- bow ground over the **Chenab River in Jammu and Kashmir.** 
 
• **Chenab Rail Bridge is an Indian road sword and concrete bow ground** between Bakkal and Kauri in the Reasi quarter of **Jammu and Kashmir,** India. 
 
• The ground has a **total length of 473.25 meters,** while the length of the viaduct is 120 meters and the central dam 94.25 meters, according to officers, adding it's supported by 96 lines. 
 
• In **April 2021** the Chenab Rail Bridge's bow was completed and it's anticipated to open to rail business in **December 2022.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Before Chenab Rail Bridge, Indian Railroads' ambitious **Bilaspur- Manali- Leh** line along the **India- China border**, is touted to be the world's **loftiest rail track**. After its completion, **Taglang La will** come the loftiest road station in the world at a height of,**359 mt above ocean position.** 
 
• The** world's longest ground is the Danyang – Kunshan Grand Bridge in China.** 
 
• **Pir Panjal road Lair, the11.2 km long road lair, passes through the Pir Panjal** Range of the **middle Himalayas in Jammu and Kashmir. **
 
• **Dhola Sadiya ground is the first largest ground in India. **
 
• Dibang River Bridge is the alternate-longest ground in India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Chenab Rail Bridge length 1315 m( 4314 ft), ** including the 650 m (2,130 ft) long viaduct on the northern side
